subject: Marketplace co-sell onboarding — technical checklist for DataLoom integration
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Alex Gomez <alex@dataloom.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace co-sell onboarding — technical checklist for DataLoom integration

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — excited about the fit between DataLoom and Redwood. To keep the marketplace listing + co-sell work moving, here's a short technical checklist that will help our GTM and engineering teams align before the co-sell enablement pack is published: 

- SKU & pricing mapping (one-line summary + preferred SKUs)
- Metering integration details (metering endpoint / shim if used)
- Demo/sandbox tenant access (username/password or API key)
- Required security artifacts (SOC2 summary, encryption/KMS notes, ptr to certs)
- Technical listing copy + image assets (1 hero image + 3 screenshots)
- Any region-specific restrictions (data residency or commercial restrictions)
- Contact for procurement/legal for marketplace contracting

Can you share the items above (PDFs or links) before our technical sync? I attached a very small co-sell pre-fill template to make it faster.

Proposed times for a 30-min technical sync: Tue 9/1 10:00–10:30 PT or Wed 9/2 8:00–8:30 PT. Ben will drive metering questions; Connor will own the listing/entitlement mapping.

Attachment: [Attachment: co-sell_prelim_template.pdf] (very small)

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Alliances (Marketplace)
Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.com

Redwood Inference | Developer-first inference platform

Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 11:03:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace co-sell onboarding — technical checklist for DataLoom integration

Stephanie,

Appreciate the clear list — we'll populate most of this by Monday. Quick answers up front:

- Metering: we run a lightweight metering shim that emits event batches to an HTTP endpoint; we can send the spec.
- Sandbox: we can provision a demo tenant and provide API keys — happy to drop creds in the meeting pre-read.
- SOC2: we have a one-page summary and the audit firm contact; full certs are shared under NDA.
- Pricing model: we support PAYG and committed monthly blocks; prefer PAYG for initial launch.

I'll attach our infra topology and a short PDF with the metering spec. Can do Tue 9/1 10:00 PT — that works for our cloud/ops lead.

Attachments: [Attachment: dataloom_infra_topology.pdf], [Attachment: metering_spec_short.pdf]

One item: is the marketplace listing compatible with a private offering (VPC/private images) for enterprise customers? We have several regulated customers that might require private deployment.

Thanks,
Alex Gomez
Head of Partnerships
DataLoom AI
alex@dataloom.ai
